QuestInfo.name: Restoring the Map
QuestInfo.1: You need #bMemory Powder#k to combine the maps into one. #bCorporal Easy of Alpha Platoon#k in Cloud Park VI should have it.
QuestInfo.2: So, Corporal Easy should have the Memory Powder...

0.0: This is it! A map straight to #b#t4031056##k... but it should not be torn. Oh, what a pity this is. I am afraid you will need #b#t4031055##k to piece this together. There is a gentlemen in Cloud Park VI named #b#p2030002##k of the Alpha Platoon who may be able to provide it for you.

npc.0: I'm studying these four pieces of #b#t4031054##k, but these don't mean a thing unless they are put together! #b#p2030002##k of Alpha platoon must have found #b#t4031055##k while investigating something around the Orbis Tower. Can you get the item for me, please? Thank you!
